final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no new admissible evidence and largely reframed the existing record. The admissible evidence still shows: aggregate readiness passed and rehearsal had no severity-one incidents; the logistics customs triage segment misses target by 1.3 percentage points; that segment is named in two freight customer commitments; policy treats such a weakness as material; and the release policy requires disclosure or approved risk acceptance before launch for a material limitation affecting a named launch use case. Legal review remains open, and there is still no admissible evidence of completed disclosure or approved risk acceptance. That means the unresolved issue is not merely a caveat on an otherwise satisfied standard; it is an unmet compliance predicate. A narrowed, caveated description of the business decision may be more accurate than a clean certification narrative, but it is not enough to move the outcome to compliant_with_caveats on this record.
remaining_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the material limitation was disclosed before launch.
No admissible evidence shows approved risk acceptance covering the material limitation before launch.
The logistics customs triage segment still misses target by 1.3 percentage points and is named in two freight customer commitments.
Product's non-core characterization does not resolve materiality under the stated policy.
Legal review on whether disclosure is required remains open, leaving a mandatory policy predicate unresolved.
Aggregate readiness and clean rehearsal support overall readiness but do not satisfy the separate disclosure-or-risk-acceptance requirement.
